$comment: Boulders and pebbles (tools/content/env/rock.mjs). Pebbles (category rock): a cluster of small rounded stones, decoration only (no collision, no concealment), grown by the terrain's plants brush on stone, gravel, snow and sand (packages/client/src/foliage.ts) and placeable as a prop; one level of detail. Boulder lods: triangle targets for meshoptimizer from the detailed surface. Collision: the hull before displacement (stone). See broadleaf.json for the fields.

notes.2: Fracture rework (owner review, 2026-11-05): 8-12 fracture planes instead of 4-7, so the collision hull (the hull before any surface detail, still <= 32 points, stone) is the new hull; bedding grooves, corner chips and crisper edges on the visual surface only (inward of the hull); rock picture drawn tri-planar.

notes.1: First version: replaces Kenney's stones in the plants brush, the scatter brushes and the palette (owner, 2026-11-05).
notes.2: Bigger, so they read at play distance (owner, 2026-11-05): stones up to about half a metre across, rounder and higher, near the size of the Kenney stones they replaced; still decoration only (no collision).
